page.layout: One printed page (p. 106), one column of running text, centred on the page. Page number at the head. No running head. Catchword "appro-" at the lower right below the last line. A marginal number "15" stands at the left of the text beside the paragraph beginning "Idem illud". The strip at the right edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ritum Christi. Ergo etiam in Tridentino eundem esse agnoscendum. ¶. Non in omnibus praesidet spiritus Christi, quod demonstravimus in loco de conciliis, in Medulla papismi. Neutiquam vero auditus est Spiritus s. in Tridentino: quia in eo multa definita sunt contra Dei verbum: Spiritus s. autem non retractat verbum suum. His adde, quod multi jactent Spiritum s. falso: quodcunq; vero illi praeter euangelium sub titulo Spiritus praetendunt vel obtrudunt, ne credamus. Christus enim semper copulat Spiritum s. & verbum, neque ullis promittit Spiritu, nisi qui docent, audiunt, & amplectuntur euangelium Joh.14.26. & alibi. ¶ Tridentinos illos patres fuisse collectos in Christi nomine. ¶. Non colliguntur in nomine Christi, quos constat a Chri-sto & euangelio ejus esse separatos: tales autem sunt quotquota ponti-ficis Romani auctoritate dependet.

page.notes: The "¶" marks are printed as pilcrow-like signs inline and are copied as ¶. The marginal "15" is read as a paragraph or section number in the left margin. The paragraph division is taken from the indented line beginning "Idem illud"; the lines before it run full and are kept as one paragraph. Italic is assumed for the summary sentences and the sentence "Tridentinos illos patres..."; none of the words are doubtful. The line "Joh.14.26." is read as printed with its stops.
